name: Hefei Metalforming Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Hefei Metalforming Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, sale, and servicing of hydraulic and mechanical presses in China and internationally. The company offers hydraulic presses, mechanical presses, color sorters, mobile crushing and screening equipment, and intelligent equipment/services. Its products are mainly used in automotive, aerospace, defense, smart home appliances, shipbuilding, rail transportation, new materials, electronics, and other industries. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.
